name: Rezolute (Nasdaq) — ersodetug, hyperinsulinism (tumor HI + congenital HI)
source: blob_sweep 2026-08-17 (dd52 -59.3%, excess vs Health Care median -0.347); court 2026-08-21; adjudicated 2026-08-22
verdict: FLAT — NAMED KILL: DATA-INTEGRITY on the catalyst calendar (cross-venue contradiction). The sponsor guides upLIFT topline 'H2 2026' (PRs 2026-05-12 and 2026-06-02), but the sponsor's OWN registry record — NCT06881992, last updated 2026-08-17, four days before court — carries estimated primary completion SEPTEMBER 2027, status recruiting, with observed enrollment velocity corroborating the registry over the guidance (8 of 16 patients since 2025-04-16 across 13 sites ~ 0.6/month -> 16/16 near mid-2027 + 8-week treatment + lock). You cannot tranche into a ~-80%-tail binary whose calendar the sponsor's own registry contradicts, and the financing runway (~Q4 CY2027 at $120M / ~$17.2M/qtr, ATM terminated) lands ON TOP of the registry readout — catalyst and forced financing collide. IMPORTANT — what the kill is NOT: red's REJECT (8/10) survives in outcome but failed in reasoning. Red's confirmatory-evidence-collapse kill (sunRIZE was the FDA's stated predicate for the n=16 design and failed) was REDUCED — the design IS restated post-failure (2026-05-12) and the FDA partially adopted the SMBG-confound argument at the 2026-03-17 Type B meeting; unresolved regulatory risk, not a proven collapse. Red's 'priced at the roof' valuation kill DISSOLVED on audit: red stacked a one-sided share count (120M FD counting options but not exercise proceeds; correct ~110M TSM) on a low multiple (3.0x for an ultra-orphan monopoly biologic; 4.0x defensible) — corrected funded prize $6.37-$9.09/sh vs $5.09 tape = fair-to-modestly-cheap at PoS=1.0, roughly fair at 55-65% PoS. Red's street-divergence kill was arithmetically wrong ($4.59 > street low $4.00) and retagged CONSENSUS.
conviction: red 8/10 REJECT -> blue 8/10 FLAT-on-calendar (not valuation); adjudicated to blue
